The main takeaway from our work is that
the optical constants of a material are not only important for the material’s intrinsic absorption properties.
the optical absorption of an ultrathin film can be maximized by choosing the optical constants in an optimal way.
the absorption in thin films of a given optical material can be increased by orders of magnitude by a judicious choice of the optical constants of this material.
